family_name: Sisalation Foam Cell and Bubble Cell

spec.description:
Sisalation Foam Cell and Bubble Cell is an advanced 3-in-1
reflective composite insulation range providing thermal insulation, a thermal
break, and a vapour barrier. Available as Foam Cell Multipurpose (8.4mm
cross-linked closed-cell foam core) or Bubble Cell (4.0mm polyethylene bubble
core) laminated between reflective aluminium foil layers with an anti-glare
coating, it reflects up to 95% of radiant heat. Engineered for steel and
timber-framed roofs and walls in residential, commercial, shed, and double-brick
applications, it features a 150mm foil overlap flap for seamless jointing and
complies with NCC thermal break requirements.
features:
3-in-1
multipurpose solution: thermal insulation, thermal break, and vapour barrier

Cross-linked closed-cell foam core (Foam Cell 8.4mm) or sealed polyethylene

Reflects up to 95% of radiant heat, providing
cooler interior conditions in hot climates

Delivers in-situ material thermal
break (R0.20 to R0.25) to satisfy NCC steel framing requirements

Anti-glare coating on outward-facing surface for safe installation in direct

High moisture and condensation resistance with Class 2 vapour
barrier rating

Extra Heavy Duty rating providing superior strength and tear
resistance

install:
Roll out over roof purlins or wall framing
with anti-glare face oriented towards the installer/outward

Align roll edges
so the 150mm factory foil flap overlaps the adjoining foam roll

Secure to
framing using mechanical fasteners or wafer-head screws with washers

Ensure a
minimum 20mm air cavity exists adjacent to the reflective face to maximize
system R-values

Tape all overlapping seams and penetrations with Vapastop 883
aluminium foil tape for continuous air/vapour seal

For steel-framed walls,
fix cladding directly through the foam cell to create a compliant R0.20+ thermal
break

At roof eaves, ensure membrane drains freely into the gutter without
pooling
selection_checklist:
Confirm requirement for thermal break
(Foam Cell 8.4mm delivers R0.20 to R0.25 on steel studs)

Verify if building
class 2-9 requires a Group 2 fire hazard rating (select Foam Cell
Multipurpose)

Choose between foam core (Foam Cell) and bubble core (Bubble
Cell) based on specification

Calculate roll quantities (each roll covers 30m²
inclusive of the 150mm overlap)
limitations:
Must be kept dry
prior to and during installation

Do not use in direct contact with wet
concrete or alkaline mortar to prevent foil corrosion

Not suitable for
applications subject to continuous water immersion

retrieval.rag_summary:
Sisalation Foam Cell and Bubble Cell is an Extra Heavy
Duty 3-in-1 reflective insulation, thermal break, and Class 2 vapour barrier
composite manufactured by Fletcher Insulation. Built with an 8.4mm closed-cell
cross-linked foam core (R0.20 to R0.25) or 4.0mm bubble core laminated between
aluminium foil faces with an anti-glare finish and a 150mm overlap flap, it
reflects up to 95% of radiant heat while preventing thermal bridging on steel
studs. Tested to AS 5637.1 (Group 2 rating for Multipurpose) and compliant with
AS 3959 up to BAL-40, it is ideal for steel-framed roofs, walls, and sheds.
